function.name: flipImageAction

flip_direction.description: Specifies the flip direction of the image. Must be either 'horizontal' or 'vertical'.

function.name: rotateImageAction
function.description: Rotates the image clockwise by a specified degree of angle. Accepts an integer value representing the angle in degrees. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

degrees.description: The degree of clockwise rotation to be applied to the image. Value must be between 0 and 360 degrees.

image_format.description: The format of the image to be rotated. For example, 'JPEG', 'PNG', 'BMP', etc.

keep_original.description: Indicates whether the original image should be kept unchanged. If set to false, the original image will be overwritten.

function.name: removeBackgroundAction
function.description: Remove the background from an image and optionally replace it with a specified color or another image. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

image_path.description: The file path to the image from which the background is to be removed.

replacement_color.description: The hex code of the color to replace the background with, e.g., '#FFFFFF' for white.

replacement_image_path.description: The file path to an image that will replace the removed background. This is ignored if 'replacement_color' is not 'null'.

output_format.description: The desired file format of the output image, such as 'PNG' or 'JPEG'.

tolerance.description: The tolerance level for background detection, ranging from 0 to 100, where a higher value means more of the background will be considered for removal.

function.name: getRecommendationsAction
function.description: Retrieves a list of recommended items based on the image provided. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

image_data.description: Base64 encoded string of the image for which recommendations are being requested.

threshold.description: The confidence threshold for filtering recommendations, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0. This is a float type value.

max_results.description: The maximum number of recommendations to return.

include_similar.description: A flag to determine whether to include similar items in the recommendations.

function.name: resizeImageAction
function.description: This function resizes an image to the specified aspect ratio while maintaining the original image proportions. It returns the resized image in the desired format. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

aspect_ratio_width.description: The width component of the desired aspect ratio for the image. Must be a positive integer.

aspect_ratio_height.description: The height component of the desired aspect ratio for the image. Must be a positive integer.

image_format.description: The file format for the output resized image. For example, 'jpeg' for Joint Photographic Experts Group format.
